title: Eval Bundle
description: Canonical, harness-independent representation of a single evaluation run. Produced by parse_eval_results.py; consumed by per-audience renderers (model card, SIM, SAFE, leaderboard). Numbers in this document are extracted deterministically from harness artifacts and are never model-generated.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Downstream renderers should refuse bundles with an unknown major version.

run_id.description: Harness-assigned run identifier, or the timestamped directory name.

framework.description: For nemo-evaluator-launcher only: the wrapped sub-framework, from run_config.yml (bigcode-evaluation-harness | lm-evaluation-harness | simple_evals).

artifact_root.description: Path the run was parsed from, as supplied to the parser.

id.description: Model identifier. Null only when the harness records none and the caller supplied none.

id_provenance.description: Whether model.id came from the artifacts or was supplied via --model-id. 'user' values are unverified against the run.

audit.description: Signals for error analysis and auditing. Populated opportunistically; absent keys mean the harness did not record them.

no_answer_rate.description: Fraction of items with no parseable answer.

llm_judge_names.description: Names of LLM judges detected alongside the run (lm-eval --run_llm_judge sidecars). Presence means scores were model-assigned, which the card must disclose.

variant.description: Prompt variant / sub-run label (NeMo-Skills robust_eval), or null.

task_yaml.description: Path to the custom task YAML (lm-eval --include_path runs). Required for reproducibility of non-registered tasks.

dataset_description.description: The benchmark's own description, from the task config metadata. Present for custom tasks that declare one.

metric.description: Normalized metric name, e.g. acc, acc_norm, pass@1, symbolic_correct.

value.description: A fraction in [0,1] when scale is fraction/percent. When scale is 'raw' this is the harness value unchanged and carries the harness's own units.

value_raw.description: The number as the harness reported it, before rescaling.

scale.description: Scale of value_raw as emitted by the harness. 'raw' means the metric is not a rate (perplexity, BLEU on 0-100, token counts, latency) and must not be presented as a fraction.

is_partial.description: True when the run was limited/truncated. Partial results must be labelled wherever they are rendered.

prompt_sensitivity.description: NeMo-Skills robust_eval: spread across prompt variants.

artifact_path.description: File this number was read from, relative to `artifact_root`. Every rendered number must be traceable to one of these.
